traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Isoetaceae and Isoetes: rosette plants, most of them aquatic, a few terrestrial and deciduous; leaves more or less linear, flat to round in section, tapering to the tip and spoon-shaped at the base, rising from a corm-like stem; the sporangia sit in the bases of the leaves, not in cones.
